label: Baseline audit — every map item, plus scoped discovery

scope.note: All inventory items not already verified against external sources on 2026-10-10 (trial 1 completion); those are carried over, not re-fetched. Discovery across SCOPE list B.

discovery.area: SCOPE B3: industry and multistakeholder bodies (FMF, PAI, EU codes) and summit/G7 commitments (Seoul, Delhi, Hiroshima/OECD)
discovery.summary: No new cross-firm commitment or code since June 2026 was found. Updates to existing entries: the HAIP Reporting Framework v2.0 (28 May 2026) and publication of v2.0 reports from 31 companies (2 Oct 2026); the GPAI Code's Signatory Taskforce, chaired by the AI Office (page updated 3 Aug 2026), with the Code itself unchanged since Jul 2025; the FMF information-sharing agreement (Mar 2025, operating), absent from the map. FMF and PAI 2026 outputs are research and guidance, not mechanisms. Seoul signatories unchanged since Feb 2025; Delhi list dated 23 Feb 2026. The G7 Évian summit (15–17 Jun 2026) adopted no AI text; Macron said AI work would be finalised in ministerial formats.
queries: "New Delhi Frontier AI Impact Commitments" text signatories
Frontier Model Forum 2026 new member OR report OR issue brief
OECD Hiroshima AI Process reporting framework 2.0 launch 2026
AI companies sign voluntary commitments 2026 frontier safety new pledge July OR August OR September 2026
G7 Evian summit June 2026 artificial intelligence leaders statement Hiroshima AI Process
Joel Kaplan Meta "won't be signing" EU code of practice general-purpose AI

direct: frontiermodelforum.org publications/feed; partnershiponai.org resources; soumu.go.jp HAIP news; oecd.ai/en/haip-2-launch; digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu GPAI pages; impact.indiaai.gov.in/outcome-resources
discovery.limits: transparency.oecd.ai (individual HAIP reports) unreachable: proxy CONNECT 502. The OECD press release (oecd.org) returned HTTP 403. LinkedIn (Kaplan post) returned HTTP 429. Web search is US-only and thin on post-June 2026 items. Industry commitments announced only by companies, or in non-English venues, may be missed.
